Maya Ramos: quick heads-up — ran v2-int8 reranker on holdout, results look mixed.
Maya Ramos: ndcg@10 up +0.2 but mrr@10 down -1.8, weird. :thinking:
Kevin Liu: hmm, that delta profile smells like score compression or more ties near the top. did the candidate pool change?
Kevin Liu: can you paste the eval output?
EvalBot: HOLDOUT RUN: model=v2-int8, ndcg@10=0.412 (+0.002), mrr@10=0.158 (-0.018), seed=42, docs_per_query=100, candidate_cut=100
Anita Patel: did we change doc preprocessing/tokenizer/truncation between the baseline and ptq run? those can shift embedding norms a lot.
Maya Ramos: we did tighten doc truncation for latency — default 1200 -> 512, and added per-doc L2 normalization before cosine scoring.
Maya Ramos: snippet of the scoring path we added:
```
# pseudocode
def score_query(q_emb, docs_emb):
    docs_emb = [truncate(d,512) for d in docs_emb]
    docs_emb = l2_normalize(docs_emb)  # new line added in PTQ path
    sims = q_emb @ docs_emb.T
    return softmax_clip(sims)
```
Kevin Liu: that l2_normalize + aggressive truncation could make many docs have very similar magnitudes -> tighter dot products -> MRR hit. try toggling the L2 step.
Anita Patel: also check candidate sourcing: we moved from bm25_top50 -> bm25_top100 then dedup. more near-duplicates can hurt MRR if ndcg tolerates duplicates.
Tom B.: I'll run a 3-way ablation: (A) remove L2 norm (B) keep 1200 truncation (C) candidate_cut=50 (same as baseline). small 500q holdout so fast.
Maya Ramos: thanks. also check the reranker head clipping — I remember we clip logits at 20 in the PTQ path before softmax, that can alter tail mass.
Kevin Liu: good call. clipping + temperature changes can compress differences. where is that configured?
Anita Patel: config: reranker.softmax_clip=20, reranker.temp=1.0 for PTQ branch. baseline had no clip.
Tom B.: starting ablations now, will post metrics and a rank-distribution plot. plan: ndcg@10, mrr@10, pairwise win-rate, tie-counts per-query.
